definitions.explanation: An authoritative directive that must be followed.
The grammatical form used for commands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{命令|めいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received an order from my boss.

examples.japanese: {命令|めいれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}わ→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{命令|めいれい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company president ordered everyone to work overtime.

examples.english: He does nothing but order his subordinates around and doesn't do anything himself.

notes:
{命令|めいれい} is an authoritative directive from someone with the power to give it — a superior, a court, an employer, a program. It is stronger and less negotiable than ⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧ (instruction) and far stronger than ⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧ (request); using it of an equal sounds high-handed.

GRAMMAR:
・As a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb the person commanded takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ and the thing commanded takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{命令|めいれい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧.
・The passive {命令|めいれい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (be ordered to) is common, since the receiving end is usually the speaker's viewpoint.
・As a noun it compounds freely: ⟦{退去|たいきょ}→退去：06693_taikyo⟧{命令|めいれい} (eviction order), {命令|めいれい}⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧ (commanding tone).

SENSE 2 (grammar):
In language teaching {命令|めいれい} is the technical label for the imperative, appearing almost always inside ⟦{命令形|めいれいけい}→命令形：22948_meireikei⟧ (imperative form) or ⟦{命令文|めいれいぶん}→命令文：28285_meireibun⟧ (imperative sentence) rather than on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{命令|めいれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to order, to command)
・{命令|めいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to issue an order)
・{命令|めいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive an order)
・{命令|めいれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧ (to obey an order)
・{命令|めいれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{背|そむ}く→背く：19577_somuku⟧ (to disobey an order)
